ABOUT THIS EXPERIENCE

A foldable idea,
made interactive.

This independent demo explores iPhone Duo’s foldable interface. It is not Apple software and does not run iOS. Photos, Notes, Settings, Camera and other screens are lightweight simulations.

The app-grid placement, side dock, and blur transition are based on the MKBHD clip you shared. This is an interactive approximation, not a frame-for-frame copy.
